Class TUIScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<TUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.TUIScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<TUIScreen>, InputEventVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConnectingScreen, DisconnectedScreen, EndGameScreen, ExitScreen, GameScreen, HomeScreen, LobbyScreen, LoginScreen, TotemPickingScreen
public abstract class TUIScreen extends Screen<TUIScreen> implements InputEventVisitor
Base abstract class for all TUI screens. Centralises the attributes and visit defaults shared by every screen so concrete subclasses only need to override what differs.

Each concrete screen represents one phase of interaction in the TUI state machine. Server responses and key presses are both delivered as ServerEvent or InputEvent object and dispatched through the visitor methods inherited from EventVisitor: returning this keeps the current screen, returning a new TUIScreen instance triggers a transition.

    • toggleLog

      protected void toggleLog()
      Toggles the full-history log window. Concrete screens should call this on the 'M' key and render drawLogPreview(TuiTextGraphics, TuiSize) when off / drawLogWindow(TuiTextGraphics, TuiSize) when on. Mirrors the legend overlay pattern in GameScreen.

    • drawLogPreview

      protected void drawLogPreview(TuiTextGraphics tg, TuiSize sz)
      Renders the last few messages bottom-right with a brightness gradient (older = dimmer). Pure no-op when the log is empty.

    • drawLogWindow

      protected void drawLogWindow(TuiTextGraphics tg, TuiSize sz)
      Renders the full log history as a boxed overlay anchored bottom-right. Shows the most recent height-3 messages so the latest entry is always on the last visible line.
